mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backtest_run (strategy_version, period_start, period_end, costs_json, metrics_json, status, created_at) VALUES (#{strategy_version}, #{period_start}, #{period_end}, #{costs_json}, '{}', 'RUNNING', datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT br.id, br.strategy_version, br.period_start, br.period_end, br.costs_json, br.metrics_json, br.status, br.created_at FROM backtest_run br ORDER BY br.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backtest_trade (run_id, trade_date, symbol, side, quantity, price, fee) VALUES (#{run_id}, #{trade_date}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{fee})
mapper.select: SELECT bt.id, bt.trade_date, bt.symbol, bt.side, bt.quantity, bt.price, bt.fee FROM backtest_trade bt WHERE bt.run_id = #{run_id} ORDER BY bt.trade_date
